$comment: Every MindAttic scheduled job (MindAttic.Scheduler, formerly MindAttic.WatchDog). install.ps1 registers each one under \MindAttic\Scheduler\ (HOUSE-LAW-11), wrapped in conhost --headless (a GUI-subsystem program is started directly). See README.md for the fields.

jobs.name: Automata.Tick
jobs.description: Automata heartbeat: resumes parked runs and runs whatever is due. Runs only while you are logged on, because browser lanes cannot render in session 0.

jobs.name: Launcher.NightlyBackup
jobs.description: Launcher nightly backup at midnight, keeping the newest 30. Runs while you are logged on; a missed midnight runs as soon as the machine is next available.

jobs.name: IdiotProof.ResearchScan
jobs.description: IdiotProof research scan: one pass an hour, run in the IdiotProof Hub (`idiotproof research scan`), the one process that talks to Alpaca and the database. Needs the Hub service running.

jobs.name: IdiotProof.MomentumCollect
jobs.description: IdiotProof: imports Momentum.'s new videos and extracts their picks, through the Hub. Local (Central) times; in ET: 07:00, 08:00, 08:45, 19:15, 20:00, 20:45, 21:30, 22:30.
jobs.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "D:\Projects\MindAttic\IdiotProof\tools\scheduled-job.ps1" -Job IdiotProof.MomentumCollect -Run "momentum import; momentum extract"

jobs.name: IdiotProof.MomentumVerify
jobs.description: IdiotProof: checks Momentum.'s finished sessions against Alpaca bars and rewrites the claims report, through the Hub. 19:10 Central = 20:10 ET.
jobs.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "D:\Projects\MindAttic\IdiotProof\tools\scheduled-job.ps1" -Job IdiotProof.MomentumVerify -Run "momentum verify; momentum report"

jobs.name: IdiotProof.GapperRadar
jobs.description: IdiotProof: ranks the next session's possible gappers (gapper study signs plus Momentum.'s picks) into the 'Gapper radar' Alpaca paper watchlist and saves the list under D:\IdiotProofData\radar, through the Hub. In ET: 20:20, 21:45, 22:45, 08:55.

jobs.name: IdiotProof.MomentumArm
jobs.description: IdiotProof paper forward test (amendment 04): at 09:29 ET arms one 1-share Paper strategy per Momentum. pick (premarket-high break), through the Hub; never Live. It skips weekends and NYSE holidays and does nothing after the 15:30 ET entry window, so a late catch-up run is harmless.

jobs.name: IdiotProof.MomentumExpire
jobs.description: IdiotProof: after the close (16:05 ET) deactivates the day's flat Momentum pick paper strategies, so a day's premarket-high levels never carry into the next session, through the Hub.

jobs.name: IdiotProof.DataMirror
jobs.description: IdiotProof: mirrors D:\IdiotProofData (gapper-study bars, SEC company facts, FINRA, halts, radar, momentum; ~35 GB) to R:\Backup\IdiotProofData with robocopy /MIR, only what changed, build scratch folders skipped (IP-T581). 02:30 Central, after the Launcher backup's busiest stretch. Log: scheduler-jobs.log.

jobs.name: JellyFinPoster.Refresh
jobs.description: Refreshes the Jellyfin Movies/TV Shows library artwork from trending TMDB titles, daily at midnight; a missed run catches up on the next wake or logon.

jobs.name: Orchestrator.Daemon
jobs.description: MindAttic Orchestrator daemon: started at logon and kept running (no time limit, restarted if it fails). Windowless; the dashboard finds it through its mutex.

jobs.name: UnstuckTaskbar
jobs.description: UnstuckTaskbar tray icon and global hotkey for /unstuck: started at logon and kept running (no time limit, restarted if it fails).

jobs.name: Lghub.LeakGuard
jobs.description: Restarts Logitech G HUB's lghub_agent once it leaks past 2 GB of private memory, hourly (lghub_system_tray relaunches it within seconds). Restarts are logged to %LOCALAPPDATA%\MindAttic\Scheduler\lghub-agent-restarts.log.

jobs.name: GridGame.Nightly
jobs.description: GridGame Gaiden nightly run (owner 2026-11-17: tests and telemetry overnight, never during the working day): the full test suite on a clean origin/main copy, bot balance soaks, a dev build and an endless telemetry run with its report, and a fix ticket per new failing test. Logs and summary.md land in Unity.GridGame/artifacts/nightly/<date>.

jobs.name: Azure.BackupNightly
jobs.description: Azure SQL backup, nightly tier (MAT-T147, docs/ops/azure-migration/BACKUP.md): a full export (bacpac) of every always-on DTU database (IdiotProof, ClaudeActivity, MindAttic.Tickets, MindAttic.Orchestrator and any other Basic/Standard database on the server) to R:\Backup\MindAttic\azure and to blob db-backups/bacpac, each checked offline, keeping the newest 14 plus 8 weekly plus 12 monthly per database on both sides. Logs: R:\Backup\MindAttic\azure\logs.

jobs.name: Prose.WikiSync
jobs.description: Keeps the GLMZ wiki (mindattic.com/glmz) up to date with the Prose database, nightly at 03:30 (M.SCHD-T40): Prose tools/wiki/sync-wiki.ps1 exports the GLMZ repos, entities, relationships and books through the Prose Hub (starting it if it is down) and pushes only the pages that changed. A run already in progress makes it exit at once (sync.lock). The last run's log (sync.log) and validation report (out\repair.md) are in %LOCALAPPDATA%\MindAttic\Prose\wiki\glmz.

jobs.name: Azure.BackupWeekly
jobs.description: Azure SQL backup, weekly and large tiers (MAT-T147, docs/ops/azure-migration/BACKUP.md). Runs every night but exports a free-offer serverless database at most once every 7 days (the four over 2 GB - Prose, IdiotProof_History, IdiotProof_Research_GAP, IdiotProof_Research_T375 - every 28 days), and never one that is paused and unchanged since its last export, so paused databases are not woken and the 100,000 vCore-second monthly allowance is kept for real work. Same destinations and offline check as Azure.BackupNightly; keeps the newest 4 plus 8 weekly plus 12 monthly per database. Logs: R:\Backup\MindAttic\azure\logs.
